snippet.title: Panic In Puzzle World - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Go and Wishlist Panic in Puzzle World on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/654860/Panic_in_Puzzle_World/
-
Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!

This trailer showcases what we've done in its first year of development! Planned for release on Steam in 2026
-
Iced Lizard Games is a very small independent game developer making the kind of games we love!
